what: Whether a whole-subject masked render makes a head turn its body mesh shows, with and without kept frames of the subject turned the other way before it
scope: one stretch of one clip (60 frames, every second read), one subject, one seed a render; a pose model's reading, nobody has watched the renders
predictor: ComfyUI core's SAM 3D Body node, release vith, on cuda:0 (bench/measure_subject_yaw.py); not this pack's body_pose.py
frames: frame 0 of the stretch is where every render has frames; the source's head turns from side-on to the camera over the first 14 frames and stays there

columns.head_off_source_degrees: mean distance of the head's facing (from the ears) from the source's, on the turn's frames and after them
columns.chin_degrees: the nose against the line between the ears on frames 30 to 55, down negative; the source lowers the head there
columns.wrist_to_nose: the nearer wrist's distance from the nose on frames 30 to 55, in torso units, median; the source brings a hand to the face there
columns.followed_in_step: bench/measure_subject_motion.py over the joints the source moves; and the same for the hands

mom_kitchen_mesh.is: the pass's second window: a continuation behind 90 kept frames, the mesh at half the canvas's short edge

mom_kitchen.is: an earlier pass of the same frames with the source's own frames as the motion video

mom_kitchen_patch_0942.is: a one-window patch on the pass's render, its new frames starting on the turn

mom_kitchen_patch_0900.is: a one-window patch on the pass's render, its new frames starting well before the turn

cont_ctx90_mesh768.is: the same continuation with the mesh at the canvas's short edge

cont_ctx90_mesh768_kvrows.is: the same with the cheaper Sol sink

fresh_0936_m768.is: a load of its own from the original, starting before the turn: no kept frames

mesh_video.is: the body mesh the renders were given, read by the same predictor

from_the_fresh_loads_first_frame.frames: 74 frames, the turn starts about 10 frames in

another_shot_same_subject.scope: 141 frames, one load, one seed a render

mom_open_mesh_ours.is: the mesh to the video model, Sol sink exact_kv_and_all_rows

mom_open_mesh_enc768.is: the mesh to the text encoder only

mom_open_mesh.is: an earlier render with core's mesh

a_load_with_no_kept_frames_that_did_not_.scope: 29 frames, a subject who is a small share of the frame behind another person; first eight frames read (the predictor's reading of the source is unsteady later, as she is covered)
